name: Step 5 Preview
short: StepFun's Step 5 Preview MoE (600B total/27B active, 1M context) for agentic coding and knowledge work; Terminal-Bench 4.0 33.3%, HLE 46.5% at $1.00/$2.70 per 1M.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
pricingNote: $1.00/$2.70 per MTok ($0.10 cache hit); no free tier
pricingTiers: $1.00 in / $2.70 out per MTok ($0.10 cache-hit input)
Rate-limit tier V0 (under $15 cumulative top-up): 5 concurrency, 100 RPM, 500K TPM
standout: StepFun’s knowledge-work MoE: 1M-context reasoning for agents and research at a mid-budget rate.
tradeoff: Preview status and uneven terminal performance mean adoption is best for experiments, not production guarantees.
notable: Domain strength against open-weight peers: on Artificial Analysis’s capability indexes (checked 2026-10-22) Step 5 Preview scores 46.2 on the Legal Index (#3 of 98 open-weight models), 52.9 on Economics (#3 of 102) and 41.1 on Healthcare & Medical (#3 of 49); the same indexes give it 45.0 on Engineering (#4 of 98) and 45.4 on Finance & Accounting (#4 of 98).

Not a frontier lead: across all models with a published index score those same AA tables rank it #57/225 (Legal), #42/232 (Economics), #49/165 (Healthcare & Medical), #42/224 (Engineering), #54/225 (Finance & Accounting) and #59/225 (Strategy & Ops) — a peer-group showing, not a top-10 finish.
